en.title: Maximum Sum of a Length-k Subarray Without Repeated Elements
en.description:
Choose a contiguous subarray of exactly k items in the array whose elements are pairwise distinct, maximizing the sum of its elements. Return -1 if there is no valid subarray. A valid maximum sum must be returned as its true value even if it is less than -1.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k, and the second line contains the array. The source has no numeric bounds; on this site 1≤n,k≤200000 (k>n is allowed), −10^9≤element≤10^9.
hints: Use a sliding window to maintain the sum and element frequencies; update the maximum sum when the length is exactly k and the number of distinct values is also k.
